title: Rulepack
description: FROZEN CONTRACT v1. A rulepack contributes rules, overrides and detectors into one shared global ID namespace. The three resolution layers (category defaults, overrides, enforcement cap) are owned by packages/core, NOT by packs. Packs never carry filesystem paths.

id.description: Pack identifier, e.g. 'supabase-rls'. Resolved by ID against the core registry; never a path.

requires.description: Pack IDs this pack depends on. Core resolves order; cycles are rejected.

categories.description: Category default table contributed by this pack. Key is category id. Core merges these; a category may be declared by exactly one pack.

id.description: Globally unique across ALL packs. Duplicate IDs across packs are a hard validation error.

severity.description: Optional override of the category default. Core still applies the enforcement cap AFTER this.

detect.description: Guidance text handed to the reviewer agent.

detectors.description: Deterministic pre-screeners. Declarative only: no Python predicates.

key.description: Unique detector key. MUST NOT be used to derive the emitted principle id - that is why emits_principle_id exists. Fixes the FA-009b collision where detectors.py:104 stripped a 'b' suffix in Python.

pattern.description: Python re syntax, applied to ADDED lines only.

include_globs.description: Path must match at least one. Replaces the _is_ts/_is_tsx/_is_sql Python predicates.

exclude_globs.description: Path must match none. Required to express FA-010 correctly: it targets Supabase imports OUTSIDE services, so services must be excluded. detectors.py:68 bound it to _is_ts with no exclusion, firing on the one legitimate case.

surface_path_globs.description: Which reviewer surfaces a changed path activates.

severity_floors.description: Per-surface severity floor contributed by this pack, e.g. rls -> high.

overlays.description: Domain overlays keyed by domain id, with path prefixes that resolve to them.
